notes: All 15 ragdoll colliders are derived from GLB JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 instead of hand-sized primitives.
Each collider is a simplified convex hull in the corresponding bone-local coordinate system.
Head collider merges head + both eye groups + both crest groups so face/top geometry is collision-protected.
Hull point counts are deliberately small for dynamic Rapier performance.
v2 limited neck joint is retained to prevent the head from folding through the torso.
